name: De-vigged probability equals raw implied normalized by the overround
description: De-vigging is defined as p_i divided by the sum of all p_j, where p_i = 1/decimal_i. The stored devigged value for each outcome must equal its raw implied value divided by the book's overround. This catches builds that store a different or arbitrary normalization.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-odds/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Pick the first book in the array and read its decimal.home, decimal.draw, decimal.away and its devigged.home, devigged.draw, devigged.away

Verify that for the home outcome the stored devigged value equals (1/decimal.home) divided by (1/decimal.home + 1/decimal.draw + 1/decimal.away), within plus or minus 0.005. The relationship must hold from the artifact's own numbers — do not compare against any externally assumed value.
